headline: Jindal Power Secures $500 Million Loan for Botswana Coal Power Plant
summary: India's Jindal Power signed an eight-year, $500 million bank loan agreement to finance a thermal power station in Botswana, leaving a remaining $500 million to be raised for the $1 billion project.
why: Jindal Power is a major Indian private energy developer expanding power plant infrastructure across Southern Africa.

impacts.name: Botswana
impacts.why: The $500 million financing advances construction of a key coal-fired power station in Botswana.
